text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about road safety and speeding in the vicinity of Secord Elementary School, which is situated in a neighbourhood home to many students and families. This lively area is home to a TTC station, community centre, and a growing number of residents, making it a priority area for increased active transportation options and road safety enhancements. I have worked with the local community to develop a number of measures to enhance safety and connectivity in the area. To keep making our community safer for all, I recommend both the installation of new measures as well as the exploration of additional ways to improve road safety for the community.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop controls at the intersections of Lumsden Avenue and Chisholm Avenue. 2. Authorized a three-way stop control at the intersections of Secord Avenue and Eastdale Avenue. 3. Authorized a three-way stop control at the intersection of Palmer Avenue and Dentonia Park Avenue. 4. Authorized a three-way stop control at the intersection of Dentonia Park Avenue and Maryland Boulevard. 5. Authorized a three-way stop control at the intersection of Avonlea Boulevard and Dentonia Park Avenue by adding a stop sign at the south-west corner of the intersection. 6. Authorized a three-way stop control at the intersection of Dentonia Park Avenue and Sibley Avenue. 7. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Dentonia Park Avenue and Thyra Avenue. 8. Authorized all-way stop controls at the intersections of Lumsden Avenue…
